headline: Sensex drops 500 points as profit booking and US Fed rate hike fears weigh on Indian markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit booking following a two-day market rally
Concerns regarding potential US Federal Reserve rate hikes
Significant declines in the metals and consumer durables sectors
Specific downward pressure from heavyweights like Titan and Bajaj Finance
whatHappening: The Sensex fell approximately 500 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,250 mark
Kaynes Technology faced a 26% target price cut after missing Q2 earnings expectations
City Union Bank reported an incident involving its NEFT services affecting customers
The Nifty IT index experienced a decline of 1.2% during the market slide
summary:
Indian benchmark indices snapped a two-day winning streak as the Sensex tumbled 500 points amid global rate hike concerns and profit taking. 
Titan and Bajaj Finance led the market drag, while Kaynes Technology saw a sharp target cut following poor quarterly results. 
Despite the volatility, some analysts suggest buying on dips as the Nifty maintains a psychological support level near 25,000.
